# Claude Code Hooks: Compaction, Model, MCP, and Worktree Events

These events cover compaction, model switches, MCP questions, and worktrees.
The events are `PreCompact`, `PostCompact`, `PreModelSwitch`, `PostModelSwitch`, `Elicitation`, `ElicitationResult`, `WorktreeCreate`, and `WorktreeRemove`.
For example, a `PreCompact` hook can block a compaction, and a `WorktreeCreate` hook can replace the default `git worktree` step.
None of these events accepts `prompt` or `agent` handlers.

## PreCompact and PostCompact

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `PreCompact` | Fires before a compaction | Matcher is `trigger`. Exit 2 or `decision: "block"` blocks it. Blocking a proactive auto compaction skips it. Blocking a recovery compaction surfaces the API error | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PreCompactHookInput` |
| ✅ | `trigger` | `manual` or `auto` | `auto` includes idle compaction | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `custom_instructions` | Text after `/compact` | `null` for `auto` or empty | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `PostCompact` | Fires after a compaction | Same matcher. No decision. Exit 2 shows stderr to the user | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PostCompactHookInput` |
| ✅ | `compact_summary` | The generated summary | | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |

## PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch

Both need 2.1.251.
The matcher is the canonical name of `to_model`.

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `PreModelSwitch` | Fires before a requested switch: `/model`, the picker, `/config`, fast mode, `set_model` | Not for automatic fallback or resume. Timeout 30 s, and a timeout blocks. Exit 2 or `decision: "block"` cancels | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PreModelSwitchHookInput` |
| ✅ | `from_model`, `to_model`, `requested_model` | Model IDs and the asked name | `requested_model` is `null` for the default | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `source` | `command`, `picker`, `sdk` | `PostModelSwitch` adds `auto` and `resume` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `context_tokens`, `prompt_cache_warm`, `cache_ttl` | The cost of a re-send | `cache_ttl` is `5m` or `1h` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `estimated_cache_write_usd`, `pricing` | The estimate and its basis | `pricing` is `configured`, `catalog`, or `default` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `permissionDecision`, `permissionDecisionReason` | `allow`, `deny`, `ask` and the reason | `ask` works only in interactive `/model`. Else it is a refusal. No `defer`, `updatedInput`, or `additionalContext`. Order `deny` > `ask` > `allow` | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `ClassicResultFields` |
| ✅ | `PostModelSwitch` | Fires after the model changes, also on fallback, `opusplan`, and resume | Cannot block. Not for a one-turn fallback chain. Plain stdout is context. Exit 2 shows stderr as a notice | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PostModelSwitchHookInput` |
| ✅ | `additionalContext` | Text for the next request | If the hook is late by 5 s, it goes to the request after | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |

## Elicitation and ElicitationResult

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `Elicitation` | Fires when an MCP server asks for user input | Matcher is the server name. A hook can answer, so no dialog shows. Exit 2 declines. `reason`, `systemMessage`, `continue` are dropped | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `ElicitationHookInput` |
| ✅ | `mcp_server_name`, `message` | Server and prompt text | | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `mode`, `url`, `elicitation_id`, `requested_schema` | `form` or `url` mode, the URL, the ID, the form schema | Optional | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `action`, `content` (out) | `accept`, `decline`, `cancel`, and form values | Read only on exit 0. A hook answer skips `ElicitationResult` hooks. A decline beats an accept | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr], bundle |
| ✅ | `decision: "block"` | Declines | Works from 2.1.284. Beats `action` | stdout | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `ElicitationResult` | Fires after the user answers, before the answer goes to the server | Matcher is the server name. Runs also on decline and cancel | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `ElicitationResultHookInput` |
| ✅ | `action`, `content`, `mode`, `elicitation_id` (in) | The user answer | `action` is `accept`, `decline`, or `cancel` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `action`, `content` (out) | Change or block the answer | `content` replaces the whole object. An output with no `action` is ignored. `cancel` still sends the user values | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |

## WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `WorktreeCreate` | Replaces the default `git worktree` step | Fires for `--worktree`, `EnterWorktree`, `isolation: "worktree"`, workflows, background sessions, and remote control. No matcher. Any non-zero exit fails it. `.worktreeinclude` is not processed | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `WorktreeCreateHookInput` |
| ✅ | `name` | Slug of the new worktree | Example `bold-oak-a3f2` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | Path on stdout | The command prints the path as the last non-empty line | ANSI codes are stripped. A relative path is resolved against the hook cwd. Absolute paths with `.` or `..`, and paths through a repo symlink, are refused | `command` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `worktreePath` | The HTTP hook returns the path | A command hook cannot return JSON here, so it cannot use `terminalSequence` | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `ClassicResult` |
| ✅ | `WorktreeRemove` | Cleans up a worktree that a `WorktreeCreate` hook made | No matcher. Exit 0 counts as removed. Non-zero fails the removal if the dir still exists. A subagent worktree is kept. JSON is dropped | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `WorktreeRemoveHookInput` |
| ✅ | `worktree_path` | Absolute path to remove | | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
